title: Dire Straits
scene: British pub rock and Anglo-American roots rock
notes: Dry bluesy guitars and intimate street narratives meet graceful rhythmic interplay and unforced singing.

title: Communiqué
scene: Laid-back British blues and country-tinged roots rock
notes: Restrained blues-rock shuffles and clean guitar counterpoint extend the debut’s spare, quietly observant sound.

title: Making Movies
scene: 1980 British roots rock with American heartland-rock production
notes: Expansive romantic narratives gain propulsive piano, sharper dynamics and more dramatic rock arrangements.

title: Love over Gold
scene: Early-1980s British progressive and art-oriented album rock
notes: Long-form atmospheric suites juxtapose patient guitar dialogues, spacious keyboards and tense narratives.
